messages:
maria_g: quick sync — want to land telemetry + viz contract for the new metering panel. goal: show cost / 1k tokens, cache & batch savings breakdown, and a simple expected vs actual unit econ line.
aj_chen: +1. can we scope the runtime inputs first? what tags do we need on requests to attribute cost properly?
kevin_w: we need model_version, quantization_profile, per-request batch_size, cache_hit (bool), cache_prefix_tokens, total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, region, and route_tag.
sasha_r: also add routing_policy (e.g., standard|fallback|low_cost) so the dashboard can split by policy.
maria_g: good call. for UX we want a 1k token normalization. agree to compute cost_per_1k = (total_cost_tokens / total_tokens) * 1000 ?
kevin_w: yeah but total_cost_tokens is derived. runtime should emit raw gpu_token_nanos and token_count so billing can map hardware cost. prefer: cost_estimate_cents = sum(kernel_cost_per_token * tokens). we'll publish normalized metric cost_per_1k_cents as a derived view.
linda_ops: ops question — do we have the kernel_cost_per_token mapping live? infra can provide a per-model/per-quant profile table that we join in the analytics pipeline.
aj_chen: pipeline join is fine. critical: include request_id and timestamp in telemetry for dedupe and windowed joins.
metrics-bot: note: new metric namespace proposal: redwood.metering.*. please review in #metrics-specs.
sasha_r: layout for dashboard: top-left KPI cost_per_1k (rolling 24h), top-right savings waterfall (cache vs batching vs quant), below: heatmap by model_version x region of per-1k cost.
maria_g: visualization requirements: savings waterfall needs three bars: cache_savings_cents, batch_savings_cents, quant_savings_cents. these must be attributable to traffic slices (route_tag, routing_policy).
kevin_w: telemetry schema suggestion (pseudo-SQL for pipeline):
```
SELECT
  route_tag,
  model_version,
  quant_profile,
  SUM(input_tokens) as total_input_tokens,
  SUM(output_tokens) as total_output_tokens,
  SUM(kernel_token_nanos) as kernel_token_nanos,
  SUM(cost_estimate_cents) as total_cost_cents,
  SUM(cache_prefix_tokens) as cache_prefix_tokens,
  SUM(case when cache_hit then 1 else 0 end) as cache_hits
FROM runtime_events
WHERE timestamp >= $window
GROUP BY route_tag, model_version, quant_profile
```
aj_chen: two implementation notes: 1) runtime needs to tag cache_prefix_tokens separately (we currently only emit cache_hit). 2) batch size distribution: we should emit batch_size_histogram bucketed (1,2,4,8,16,32+).
kevin_w: ack, I'll add those spans. we can emit batch_size_bucket and batch_processing_nanos.
linda_ops: for rollout UX: when we roll a new quant_profile the dashboard should show a shaded canary stripe and linked eval set results. product wants a one-click compare between old/new.
sasha_r: agree. also add a time-series for rollback triggers: percent change in per-1k > threshold triggers annotation.
maria_g: action items: kevin to add cache_prefix_tokens, batch_size_bucket, kernel_token_nanos; aj to spec event schema + request_id; linda to own infra join table for kernel_cost per profile; sasha to draft dashboard wireframe where savings are decomposed by slice; me to write the dashboard acceptance tests (promises: compare derived vs billed values).
aj_chen: putting a tiny schema PR up in 1h. tagging @kevin_w for review.
kevin_w: will review and start instrumenting runtime in next patch.
linda_ops: I'll prototype the cost join table and share SQL for validation by EOD tomorrow.
maria_g: awesome. thanks team :rocket:
